description: Get a specific product variant by ID, including billing interval and trial settings. WARNING: do NOT read `price` as the amount charged. For usage-based, per-seat or otherwise tiered variants it is vestigial and commonly reads the same value across products that bill very differently. The authoritative per-unit price lives on the variant's PRICE resource -- call ls_list_prices with this variantId, take the newest record by `created_at`, and read its `effective_unit_price`.
name: ls_get_variant
